bestKnown: The dataset witnesses ARE the best-known solutions: each was produced by escalating search budgets (6M -> 24M -> 60M evaluations/color, then two no-cap passes); no better witness is known for any instance.

columns.description: INTEGER 0..16777215: target color packed 0xRRGGBB (red high byte); hex string is '%06X' % id
columns.name: id

columns.description: NUMERIC: invert() amount in percent (the CSS-facing value; verifier divides by 100)
columns.name: invert

columns.description: NUMERIC: saturate() amount in percent (commonly tens of thousands)
columns.name: saturate

columns.description: NUMERIC: contrast() amount in percent (may exceed 100)
columns.name: contrast

columns.description: NUMERIC: achieved rendered loss of the witness chain (the stored `loss` column; always < 1; metric = sum of absolute RGB and HSL deltas, see docs/dataset.md)
columns.name: loss

description: Fully-solved 6-parameter nonlinear benchmark: one record per sRGB color (16,777,216 instances). The witness parameter vector is the best-known solution; `loss` is the achieved objective value under the dataset's rendered-loss metric; the covering threshold 1 defines 'solved'.

format: CSV (gzip, level 9); header line first; LF newlines; no quoting (no field ever contains a comma or quote)
